title: Ada and the Deadline
author: Juniper Whitlock
blurb: Theo Iversen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
